description: Floating popover for a text-anchored (highlight) comment thread, showing the highlighted-text preview, entries with reactions, watch and resolve, edit and delete, and a reply input, toggling the highlight's active state.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the TmNotionCommentDraftState value changes - the bottom reply/new-comment composer, the inline reply or the entry edit gained/lost content. Value-equality deduped, so it does NOT fire on every keystroke. No composer text is observable through a parameter; use TmNotionCommentDraftState to build a dirty-guard before closing the panel or navigating away. The inline reply's auto-inserted quote and an untouched edit are not user content and do not raise HasUnsavedContent. Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard after the consumer's own confirmation.
